description: The invariants. An agent generating a Hardstock surface must satisfy every error-level rule. tools/validate.mjs checks the ones marked machineCheckable.

invariants.statement: border-radius is 0 on every element, including avatars, toggles, radio inputs, pills and modals.
invariants.why: One rounded corner reads as generic SaaS and drags the whole page with it.
invariants.detect: any border-radius declaration with a non-zero value
invariants.fix: Set it to 0. Add the global reset `*,::before,::after{border-radius:0}` so component libraries cannot leak defaults.

invariants.statement: Every box-shadow has a blur radius of 0. Depth is displacement, never softness.
invariants.why: A soft shadow is the single fastest way back to a template look.
invariants.detect: box-shadow with a third length value that is not 0
invariants.fix: Use shadow.xs / sm / md / lg from tokens.json.

invariants.statement: Text on any colored fill is ink. Never muted grey, never white.
invariants.why: The palette is high-luminance; grey on it fails contrast and looks washed.
invariants.fix: color: var(--hs-ink) on every colored block, in light and dark themes alike.
invariants.note: The general form needs eyes. Its most common mechanical form is checked as on-fill-on-neutral.

invariants.statement: A component never puts on-fill text on a neutral surface (canvas or any surface fill).
invariants.why: on-fill is frozen across themes; the neutral surfaces are not. Pairing them paints dark text on a dark surface the moment a dark theme loads. This is the mechanical half of ink-on-fill, and it is the defect this project has shipped most often.
invariants.detect: a declaration block setting color to an on-fill token together with a background resolving to a neutral surface token
invariants.fix: Neutral surfaces take ink. on-fill belongs to the colored variants only.

invariants.statement: A page uses exactly one accent for primary actions and highlights. Other palette colors appear only as status or category, never as a second brand color.
invariants.why: Two accents means neither is one.
invariants.detect: more than one categorical color used on primary buttons or hero highlights
invariants.fix: Pick one from themes.json. Move the rest to badges and avatars.

invariants.statement: The accent carries brand, not meaning. Success, warning, danger and info come from color.semantic.
invariants.fix: Success is lime, danger is pink, info is cyan. Warning may reuse yellow only when yellow is not the accent.

invariants.statement: No card inside a card, no stacked shadows. Regions are tiled and separated by hard borders.
invariants.why: Brutalism partitions with lines, not with layers.
invariants.fix: Flatten. Use a 2px rule or a border between sections of one block.

invariants.statement: No bounce, no spring, no overshoot easing, no scale-up on hover, no blur or backdrop-filter transitions.
invariants.detect: cubic-bezier with a control point outside [0,1] on the y axis, transform: scale() above 1, filter/backdrop-filter blur
invariants.fix: Hover is translate plus a shadow step. Easing is cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), duration at most 0.15s.

invariants.statement: No emoji in UI chrome, headings, buttons or badges.
invariants.why: Emoji are rounded and multicolor. They fight an ink-and-hard-edge system.
invariants.fix: Monoline SVG at 1.5 to 2px stroke, or an uppercase mono label. Geometric characters such as arrows and a multiplication sign are fine.

invariants.statement: A prefers-reduced-motion block disables float, pulse and every transform transition.
invariants.detect: stylesheet with animations but no prefers-reduced-motion media query

invariants.statement: Colored status always carries a word or a monoline icon as well.
invariants.why: Lime, pink and cyan are indistinguishable to a large share of colorblind users.
invariants.fix: Badges read ONLINE, ERROR, INFO in uppercase mono next to the fill.

invariants.statement: :focus-visible draws a 2px ink outline with 2px offset, globally, and is never removed.
Clickable things are button or a elements. Overlays close on Escape and trap focus.
invariants.fix: Replace div-with-onclick. Add keydown handling for Escape on every overlay.

invariants.statement: Components reference tokens by CSS variable. Raw hex belongs in the token block only.
invariants.detect: hex literal outside :root or @theme that is not in the token set

invariants.statement: Multi-column layouts scroll horizontally rather than crush a column below usable width.
invariants.fix: Give the main column minmax(380px, 1fr). Collapse secondary columns under 900px. Badges get white-space:nowrap and flex-shrink:0.

invariants.statement: A long page mixes three to four block archetypes and repeats none more than twice.
invariants.why: A page that is nothing but an icon-title-description grid is the strongest generated-content tell there is.

mediumScope.note: The invariants above are written for screen. These ids have no meaning on paper and are dropped in print: everything else still applies.

printInvariants.statement: Hairline rules and small text print K-only, set to overprint.
printInvariants.why: Four-color hairlines misregister and fringe. This language is built almost entirely from hairlines, so getting it wrong ruins the piece rather than one element.
printInvariants.fix: Black channel only, overprint on. Never knockout a hairline.

printInvariants.statement: Large solid ink areas use a rich black. Small text and hairlines never sit on top of one.
printInvariants.why: K-only solids read as washed grey next to real black; rich black under small text fringes on registration.
printInvariants.fix: Around C40 M30 Y30 K100, confirmed with the printer.

printInvariants.statement: The offset shadow is a drawn shape in the same ink as its rule, never an application shadow effect.
printInvariants.why: Effect-panel shadows rasterise with blur and force transparency flattening. Split inks destroy the register the offset depends on.
printInvariants.fix: Duplicate the shape, offset it by the derived amount, place it behind, same ink.

printInvariants.statement: Every rule weight is at or above the minimum for the printing process.
printInvariants.why: Below the floor a hairline breaks up or vanishes on press.
printInvariants.fix: See tokens.json print.minimumRuleWeight. Raise the rule rather than preserve the ratio.

printInvariants.statement: Rules sit at least 5mm inside the trim, or run fully off a 3mm bleed. Never between.
printInvariants.why: Trim tolerance is about 1mm, and the eye measures that gap against a parallel rule.
printInvariants.fix: Move it in, or run it off the edge. There is no acceptable middle.

printInvariants.statement: No gradients, transparency, blend modes or RGB left in the file.
printInvariants.fix: Same discipline as the screen version, with worse consequences: these force flattening and shift color at RIP.

printInvariants.statement: A layout moved to a new size is re-derived from the new body size, never scaled.
printInvariants.why: Scaling preserves the ratios and silently walks the rule weight through the process minimum.
printInvariants.fix: Set the new body size, recompute from tokens.json print.derivation.

printInvariants.statement: Anything with a saturated accent gets a physical proof on the actual stock before the run.
printInvariants.why: Screens misrepresent exactly the colors this palette leans on.

smellTests: Screenshot it and squint. If it could be any generic SaaS product, the grammar has leaked.
Search the built CSS for 'radius' and 'blur'. Both should be absent or zero.
Count distinct accent fills on primary buttons. Should be one.
Tab through it. Every stop should be obvious.
